description: Send a quote request to the studio for a person, like the site's quote form. Ask the person first: use only their real name and phone or email, describe the project in message, and set consent to true only after they agreed to be contacted. Returns a reference number; the studio usually answers within one business day.

consent.description: true only if the person agreed that the studio contacts them about this request and accepted the privacy policy.

email.description: Email address. Phone or email is required.

message.description: What to print: object, size, quantity, purpose, links to files or references.

name.description: Full name of the person asking for the quote.

phone.description: Israeli phone number, e.g. 050-1234567. Phone or email is required.

project_type.description: Kind of project, e.g. one of GET /quote-options project_type.

scale.description: Model scale for architectural models, e.g. 1:100.

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
